INSERT INTO market_daily (symbol, trade_date, open, high, low, close, volume, amount, adj_flag, data_source, ingested_at) VALUES
(#{item.symbol}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.open}, #{item.high}, #{item.low}, #{item.close}, #{item.volume}, #{item.amount}, #{item.adjFlag}, #{item.dataSource}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open = VALUES(open), high = VALUES(high), low = VALUES(low), close = VALUES(close), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount), adj_flag = VALUES(adj_flag), data_source = VALUES(data_source), ingested_at = NOW()
